t: You're looking at St George's Cathedral in Southwark, the Roman Catholic cathedral of the Archdiocese of Southwark and the seat of its Archbishop. It was designed by Augustus Pugin, the English architect and designer who pioneered the Gothic Revival style. Pugin is also remembered for the interior of the Palace of Westminster and its clock tower, nicknamed Big Ben. He designed many churches in England, and some in Ireland and Australia. His sons carried on the family firm as Pugin & Pugin.
